basis: Non-whitespace characters in rendered DOM text, including navigation/forms; excludes hidden/collapsed UI, image lettering, canvas/SVG text. Synthetic account with representative public catalog books and working cover images. Percentages depend on content and state.
notes: Percentages group visible non-whitespace DOM characters by computed font face; glyph-level rendering samples are provided separately.
Navigation, selected options, and input placeholders count; image lettering, canvas/SVG text, hidden or collapsed content, and CSS-generated content do not.
Full page includes text below the initial viewport that is part of the rendered page state. Views with internal clipping expose only their current content.
The account is synthetic. Lists use representative public catalog books with successfully decoded covers; proportions vary with titles, descriptions, screen width, and application state.
Some Inter 600 samples in filtered recommendations used SegoeUI-Semibold rather than the requested face. The existing optional font-display policy allows fallback.
